title: feat(triage): answer author role rules from team membership
body:
An author rule on a pack role that names teams was always unsure, because the facts did not know who is in a team.

## What changed

- GitHub tool 0.3.2: `github_author_teams` ({repo, author, teams} → {teams, unknown}) reads `GET /orgs/{org}/teams/{slug}/memberships/{user}` for the teams the pack's roles name, at most 20, deduped by slug; active = member, pending or a confirmed non-member = not, team missing, other org, user-owned repository, 403 or any error = unknown. `teamSlug` moved to the contracts (`@corbits/triage-contracts/team`) and lowercases slugs, shared by the tool and the actions.
- Facts carry `authorTeams` and `authorTeamsUnknown`, read once per distinct author per batch and only when a role names a team; the preview route does the same and treats a failed read as unknown.
- A role gate answers yes when the author is in its users or a confirmed team, no when every team is confirmed not, unsure only when a team is unknown.
- GitHub App manifest adds organization members: read; the README notes existing installs must accept it.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun --conditions=intx-src test packages/github-tool packages/triage-workflows packages/triage-contracts apps/web/scripts` and the manifest test.
- Live local sidecar run against a fake GitHub with one team: a role gate on `@acme/core` answered yes for the member on three PRs and its action took the yes branch, and answered no for a bot author.

Closes CL-XXXX
